title: Decentralized Intent
tagline: Project focuses on leveraging Waku technology to decentralize the communication flow within the 1inch Fusion Mode API, thereby enhancing privacy, security, and censorship resistance for users engaged in swaps.

prizes.title: Most Innovative Application on top of 1inch Network's Fusion API

description: The goal is to transition the existing centralized 1inch Fusion Mode API to a decentralized architecture using Waku technology. This transition aligns with the broader ethos of decentralized technologies and contributes to the advancement of decentralized finance by reducing reliance on centralized infrastructure.
how_its_made: This project utilizes the Waku peer-to-peer network to maintain the latest order book for resolvers, thereby eliminating reliance on the 1inch Fusion API. More importantly, it enables anyone to operate their own node and synchronize with the Waku network, ensuring access to all orders and achieving true decentralization.
